intel.title: [CISA KEV] MikroTik RouterOS - MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-86060
廠商: MikroTik
產品: RouterOS
漏洞名稱: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
說明: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-13
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此漏洞（CVE-2026-86060）存在於 MikroTik RouterOS 中，由於命令參數分隔符未妥善處理，攻擊者可藉此修改 RouterOS 策略遮罩並提升權限。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV），具備高度危害性。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] MikroTik RouterOS - MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-67277
廠商: MikroTik
產品: RouterOS
漏洞名稱: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
說明: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authenticaion for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-13
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此情資指出 MikroTik RouterOS 存在關鍵功能缺失身分驗證漏洞（CVE-2026-67277），攻擊者可利用 btest 服務進行核心記憶體洩露或發動拒絕服務（DoS）攻擊。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV），顯示已有活躍的攻擊活動。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
